evidence_items.explanation: Salesforce's clarification distinguishes redeployment, attrition, and non-backfilling from the reported mass dismissal. The report does not provide a staffing-and-workflow record sufficient to determine which complete roles AI sustainably replaced; the direct response is available here through news reporting.

The study links AI adoption to lower spending on contracted online labor through Q3 2025. Its population fits the conceded contract exception, its period precedes the target quarter, and it does not establish replacement quality or complete employee-role substitution.

unresolved_gaps: No reviewed record connects a qualifying employee-role elimination during the target quarter to sustained AI performance of the transferred work.
The Salesforce clarification does not disclose a complete before-and-after staffing and task ledger.
Contractor spending substitution does not establish the quality or scalability of replacements.
